name: metamynd-mcp-gateway
description: Put an AI app's MCP servers behind the MetaMynd gateway: every tool call is allowed, refused or held for a person before it runs.

interface.shortDescription: Allow, refuse or hold MCP tool calls before they run
interface.longDescription: Sets up the MetaMynd gateway between an AI app and its MCP servers. The gateway holds the tools' credentials and checks each call against the agent's mandate.
defaultPrompt: Put this app's MCP servers behind the MetaMynd gateway
